<style type="text/css">
/* ==========================================================================
   LIBRARY THEME (Version: 23.4)
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   * ELEMENTS
      : Actions
      : Fields
      : Thumbnails
         : FileField
      : Buttons
         : Iconographics
         : Registration/application
             : Customizables

   * COMPONENTS
      : Dynamic menu

   * MODULES
      : Banner

   * PAGETYPES
      : Blocking login
   ========================================================================== */

/* ELEMENTS: Actions
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.addDatasetRow,
.action--add {
    --action__icon--background--image: url(https://synopsys.avature.net/portal/4/images/icon--add.svg);
}

.removeDatasetRow,
.removeFile,
[id*="dropboxRemove_"],
.fileInputCancelButton,
.action--remove {
    --action__icon--background--image: url(https://synopsys.avature.net/portal/4/images/icon--remove.svg);
}

.action--delete {
    --action__icon--background--image: url(https://synopsys.avature.net/portal/4/images/icon--remove.svg);
}

.action--edit {
    --action__icon--background--image: url(https://synopsys.avature.net/portal/4/images/icon--edit.svg);
}

/* to de deleted after we migrate to typographic icons (this is here and not in core.css due to a FF bug) */
.action:before,
.addDatasetRow:before,
.removeDatasetRow:before,
.removeFile:before,
[id*="dropboxRemove_"]:before,
.fileInputCancelButton:before {
    mask-image: var(--action__icon--background--image);
    -webkit-mask-image: var(--action__icon--background--image);
}

/* ELEMENTS: Fields
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

:root {
    --fields--icon--caret--down: url(https://synopsys.avature.net/portal/4/images/icon--caret--down.svg);
    --fields--icon--caret--down--disabled: url(https://synopsys.avature.net/portal/4/images/icon--caret--down--disabled.svg);
    --fields--icon--caret--up: url(https://synopsys.avature.net/portal/4/images/icon--caret--up.svg);
    --fields--icon--clear: url(https://synopsys.avature.net/portal/4/images/icon--clear.svg);
}

/* ELEMENTS: Thumbnails: FileField
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

.FileField {
    --thumbnail--background--image: url(https://synopsys.avature.net/portal/4/images/icon--user.svg);
}

/* ELEMENTS: Buttons: Iconographics
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

.ui-button.ui-dialog-titlebar-close {
    --button__icon--background--image: url(https://synopsys.avature.net/portal/4/images/close.svg);
}

/* ELEMENTS: Buttons: Registration/application: Customizables
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

.methodButton--later {
    --buttons__icon--background--image: url(https://synopsys.avature.net/portal/4/images/icon--later.svg);
}

.methodButton--file {
    --buttons__icon--background--image: url(https://synopsys.avature.net/portal/4/images/icon--file.svg);
}

.methodButton--paste {
    --buttons__icon--background--image: url(https://synopsys.avature.net/portal/4/images/icon--paste.svg);
}

/* to de deleted after we migrate to typographic icons (this is here and not in core.css due to a FF bug) */
.methodButton--later:before,
.methodButton--file:before,
.methodButton--paste:before {
    mask-image: var(--buttons__icon--background--image);
    -webkit-mask-image: var(--buttons__icon--background--image);
}

/* COMPONENTS: Dynamic menu
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

@media all and (max-width:1024px) {
    :root {
        --header--height: 5.5rem;
    }
}

@media all and (min-width:1024px) {
    .body--menu--threshold .menu--visible .menu__panel {
        flex-wrap: nowrap;
        justify-content: flex-end;
        align-items: flex-start;
        border-top: solid .1rem var(--dividers--border--color);
        padding-top: var(--header--padding--top);
        margin-top: var(--header--padding--top);
    }

    .body--menu--threshold .menu__list {
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        justify-content: flex-start;
    }

    .body--menu--threshold .header__content {
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: flex-start;
    }

    .body--menu--threshold .header__menu {
        width: 100%;
    }

    .body--menu--threshold .menu--visible .menu__list {
        flex-grow: 1;
    }

}

/* MODULES: Banner
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

:root {
    --banner--background--image: url(https://synopsys.avature.net/portal/4/images/bannerBg.png);
}

/* Media query to target only tablet */
@media all and (min-width:751px) and (max-width:1024px) {
    :root {
        --banner--background--image: url(https://synopsys.avature.net/portal/4/images/bannerBg.png);
    }

}

/* Media query to target only mobile */
@media all and (max-width:750px) {
    :root {
        --banner--background--image: url(https://synopsys.avature.net/portal/4/images/bannerBg.png);
    }

}

/* PAGETYPES: Blockin login
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

:root {
    --login__body--background--image: url(https://synopsys.avature.net/portal/4/images/login--bg--desktop.jpg);
}

/* Media query to target only tablet */
@media all and (min-width:751px) and (max-width:1024px) {
    :root {
        --login__body--background--image: url(https://synopsys.avature.net/portal/4/images/login--bg--tablet.jpg);
    }

}

/* Media query to target only mobile */
@media all and (max-width:750px) {
    :root {
        --login__body--background--image: url(https://synopsys.avature.net/portal/4/images/login--bg--mobile.jpg);
    }

}
